entities.name: Maria Albuleț
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Albuleț, also Maria Pogorevici and Maria Albuleț-Pogorevici, was a Romanian doctor and chess player who held the FIDE title of Woman Grandmaster (WGM) since 1985. She was a three-time winner of the Romanian Women's Chess Championship.
